facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A shoemaker was poor. He had one piece of leather. He used scissors. He cut the leather.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Once upon a time, a poor shoemaker lived in a small shop. He only had one last piece of leather left. He cut the leather carefully into the shape of shoes. He planned to finish sewing them the next morning. He left the pieces on his workbench and went to sleep. He did not know something magical would happen that night.
facts.Word cards: shoemaker = 구두장이 / leather = 가죽 / cut = 자르다 / night = 밤
